headline: Tesla to Wind Down Cybertruck Production to Focus on Robotics and AI
summary: Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production around the middle of next year as CEO Elon Musk shifts focus toward robotics, AI, and the Cybercab self-driving taxi at its Texas factory.
why: Tesla is a major player in the electric vehicle and autonomous driving markets, and shifts in its capital expenditure and production lines directly impact its future growth strategy and competitive standing.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: The company is winding down a major product line to reallocate its factory space for autonomous vehicles.
